    )", "new": "def slugify_params(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build the keyword arguments for :func:`slugify` from parsed CLI arguments.

    The parsed ``regex_pattern`` value is forwarded unchanged (including ``None``)
    so the CLI applies the same custom disallowed-character pattern as the library
    call. All other CLI options, positional/STDIN input, and case/Unicode behavior
    are preserved.
    """
    return dict(
        text=args.input_string,
        entities=args.entities,
        decimal=args.decimal,
        hexadecimal=args.hexadecimal,
        max_length=args.max_length,
        word_boundary=args.word_boundary,
        save_order=args.save_order,
        separator=args.separator,
        stopwords=args.stopwords,
        regex_pattern=args.regex_pattern,
        lowercase=args.lowercase,
        replacements=args.replacements,
        allow_unicode=args.allow_unicode
    )"}]}
